extension.description: View plain text as a compact, collapsible outline of all lines or a view that makes headings easier to identify.
configuration.title: Plain Text Outline Navigator
configuration.displayMode.description: Choose All Lines or a view that makes headings easier to identify.
configuration.displayMode.allLines.descr: Show all lines in a compact, collapsible view of the entire document.
configuration.displayMode.headingFocused: Hide indented lines without children, which are likely to be content, to make headings easier to identify. Root lines are always shown.
configuration.symbolKind.description: Choose the symbol icon used for outline entries.
